I had to rush my dog to the emergency animal hospital where she was diagnosed with open pyometra. She was in a lot of pain and experiencing excessive bleeding, and I was advised to book her surgery immediately.
After calling around to several hospitals for quotes and availability, I remembered my previous positive experience at Blue Cross. They were exceptionally thorough from the start, breaking down every detail of the surgery and explaining the necessity of each item. They provided clear options ranging from low- to high-end, along with realistic expectations.
What stood out the most was their genuine care. I have a Cane Corso, a breed that many people find intimidating. While she is friendly with people and not fond of other dogs, she was in severe pain and very protective of her belly. The team at Blue Cross understood dog body language, respected all breeds, and handled her with incredible caution. Instead of turning us away out of fear, which has happened with other vets; they worked patiently around her discomfort to keep her as calm as possible. I was there to support the staff to ensure safe and smooth process.
The surgery went smoothly, and I am so grateful to Dr. Swarney and Nejra the technician for their exceptional care and professionalism and Heather receptionist was amazing and cool. I think I’ve finally found our permanent vet :)

I am sharing this story to help other pet parents who might find themselves in a medical crisis. Ten years ago, we brought our beloved 12-year-old German Shepherd in, and she was diagnosed with pyometra. Dr. Eaglesome rightfully told us she needed to go to the emergency hospital. Because we trusted her and the clinic so much, we asked if she could just stay there overnight instead.
Although we were told there would be no overnight care, we didn't fully grasp the severity of the situation or realize she was in immediate danger of dying without active monitoring and fluids. We left her there, believing she would make it until morning to have surgery. Our healthy, active girl—who still ran and played every day—was left alone from 6:00 PM until the next morning. Although it did feel like a long time for us we trusted in the Dr's approval. When staff arrived between 7:00 and 8:00 AM, she had apparently just passed away.

I know the specific vet involved is no longer at this practice, and my intention isn't to condemn the current team. But ten years later, we still carry the immense pain of knowing our girl might have survived if we had just taken her to the emergency hospital like we were initially told. I hope that by sharing this, if another pet parent is ever given the choice, they will always choose the emergency room. Don't let a fear of the unknown or a false sense of security keep you from getting your pet the immediate, 24-hour care they need.

Been taking my 9 year old lab mix to BCAH since she was a pup. Though worms as a pup, dietary issues, an estrogrogen deficiency, pain management for dysplasia, and, most recently, removing a cracked tooth, the vets and care at BCAH have been wonderful. New puppy, now 10 months, has received the same care and attention. Staff are friendly, prices are fair (dental for the cracked tooth was cheaper than quotes from specialist), and we’ve never once felt like “extras” were being suggested to increase the bill; decisions about care have always felt like they were being made by us, never by the vet.

We adopted a dog in February,  who was a stray. He’s ended up having many medical issues, and Blue Cross has been amazing every step of the way. The first day I brought our dog in for his eye issue, Dr. Ellison was very thorough. He promptly called a dog ophthalmologist and even phoned me later in the evening after he spoke with the ophthalmologist. Because of his diligence, we were able to get our dog started on treatment and avoid him losing the eye! Since then, we’ve had more medical issues, including an urgent visit for dehydration and a recent dental under anesthesia. Dr. Ellison and every other vet we’ve seen (Dr. Karim, Dr. Wong, Dr. Hosseini) have been kind, caring and knowledgeable. They are also very transparent and practical regarding treatment recommendations and pricing. The clinic is very well run with incredibly friendly and helpful technicians and client care reps. It is super easy to book an appointment, get an urgent appointment  and get records needed for pet insurance claims. I’ve never needed to wait long for any appointment or get in touch with the front desk by phone.  However, if I did, I’d know it’s because they were taking the time when needed to care for the animal before me, given how comprehensive they are. For the recent dental exam, the procedure was well outlined, and the team communicated well during the day about our dog’s status.  While I have not gone to other vets, the prices seem comparable to others in the area, which I consider a great value for the excellent service. Thank you so much Blue Cross!
